dependencies.evidence: The official title identifies Decree 113/2007 as implementing Act I of 2007; the consolidated text's opening provisions cite that Act as the authorization basis.
The decree's final provision states that it serves to comply with Directive 2004/38. This does not establish an article-by-article national implementation map.
Section 4 identifies Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 (Visa Code) for short-stay visa procedures.
